name: NMDC Steel Limited
summary: NMDC Steel Limited manufactures and sells steel products in India. It offers hot rolled coils, sheets, and plates of welded steel pipe for pipeline transportation systems; structural and silicon steel; pig iron; and LPG grades of LPG cylinders manufacturing. The company also provides tube and pipe grade, boiler and pressure vessel grade, commercial forming grades, cold rolling grade, and HSLA Grade. It serves infrastructure and construction; automotive and mobility; energy, oil, and gas; and engineering and fabrication industries. NMDC Steel Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
